name: Rot ～Tasogare no Hate～
source: Sakura Hayato had been living in the hospital for a long time, but his illness was finally cured recently and he was discharged. As part of his rehabilitation, he ends up living alone in a rural village, but...
translation: 佐倉隼人長期住院，直到最近才終於痊癒出院。為了康復休養，他開始在一個鄉村裡獨自生活，可是……
